title: Lotuslite V2: The Evolution of Mustang Panda's .NET Backdoor
description: Lotuslite V2 is a .NET-based backdoor malware attributed to the Mustang Panda threat actor, targeting government and diplomatic entities in Thailand. It is delivered via a public Zoho WorkDrive link containing a ZIP archive themed as an assessment. The infection chain uses a signed PDFgear executable for DLL side-loading, establishes persistence through registry modifications, and communicates with command-and-control servers over TCP using AES-256-GCM encrypted application-layer traffic. This variant represents an evolution from the original C++ LOTUSLITE malware, featuring enhanced cryptographic protections and refined command routing techniques.
